_wholesale_comment: Site-wide wholesale policy shown on every product page and the Wholesale Process page. These are sensible starting defaults, not fabricated per-product data — update them here once real MOQ, packaging and lead-time policy is confirmed, and every page picks it up automatically.

wholesale.moq: 50 pieces per style (mixed sizes and colours accepted)
wholesale.packaging: Standard export packaging — polybagged with barcode label, packed in bulk cartons
wholesale.leadTime: Typically 2–4 weeks for bulk orders, depending on quantity and stock availability
wholesale.supplyRegion: UAE-wide, with GCC export available on request
wholesale.quoteValidity: 7 days from the date of issue
wholesale.sampleNote: Sample units may be available on request prior to bulk confirmation

whatsappTemplates.general: Hi Hadaf Venture Trading, I'd like to enquire about wholesale garment supply.
whatsappTemplates.product: Hi Hadaf Venture Trading, I'm interested in wholesale pricing and MOQ for "{name}" (SKU: {sku}). Could you share more details?

_partners_comment: Confirmed wholesale/distribution partners shown in the logo showcase on the Homepage, About Us and Partner With Hadaf pages. Only list a company here once the partnership is genuine and confirmed. Drop each company's official logo file into src/data/partner-logos/ named `{id}.svg` (or .png/.webp/.jpg) — see src/lib/real-logos.js.
